game_title: String Glue – Cinder Cone Camp Trial
game_concept: A puzzle set in Mt. Pyre – Cinder Cone Camp, a camp on a cinder slope: the fire warden must handle ash wraiths while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – String Glue: Concatenate string pieces to forge passwords and spell names.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Cinder Cone Camp: a camp on a cinder slope
core_gameplay_loop: In Cinder Cone Camp, repeat each round: Concatenate string pieces to forge passwords and spell names. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the spell_ok value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Reach the cooling vent using at most 19 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
win_condition: The cooling vent reached with actions_used <= 19.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 19 before the cooling vent is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 2 – Data Types & Operators | Level 3 (intro tier): String Glue
assets_style: pixel-art volcano: purple-black rock, glowing lava rivers, orange ember light, drifting ash; flat Kenney-style sprites; low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how spell_ok changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against ash wraiths in Cinder Cone Camp.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The cooling vent reached with actions_used <= 19.
